name: turbocharged_engine_expander
title: Turbocharged engine with expander temperature drop (TP6 exercise 2)
summary: Teaching exercise: air and fuel mass flows of a turbocharged eight-cylinder engine, with the volumetric efficiency defined on the ambient density, and the useful power of an expander whose temperature drop is given.

origin.course: ULiège MCI, TP6, sixth exercise session, statement 2 (turbocharged engine with an expander temperature drop)
